description: Going Commando's Charge Boots charge on Clank's Thruster-Pack, running Going Commando's own code: with the Thruster-Pack on, double-tap R1 and hold to charge, steering with the stick, its flames blue; enemies in the way are hit. Needs OpenRAC with the hook points of OpenRAC #617 (merged; in the next release).

screenshots.caption: A charge down a tunnel on Clank's Thruster-Pack, its flames blue.
